cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a training simulator bay — holds her keepsake at chest height; a quiet observatory planetarium foyer with a circular bench — she offers the better half of her oversized sesame bun toward the viewer; a rooftop surf-wave practice basin under a peach evening sky — she has just climbed out after an enthusiastic practice run and laughs while carrying her lightweight training board back to the rail; a calligraphy classroom with low wooden desks — holds a cup in both hands; a sunny ranch — standing; an outdoor pool with lounge chairs and clear blue water — sitting on the ground; a hydroponic garden dome aboard a starship — sitting on the ground; an ice palace hall of carved crystal pillars — seated sideways on a stool or bench; a bright bathroom with a mirror — brushes her hair with a hairbrush; a hydroponic bathing pool aboard a starship — holds a small hand lantern low at her side; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — checks the photo on the back screen of a camera at chest height; a Peking opera dressing room — standing; a museum hands-on workshop table before opening — seated on a chair
